svg.text: 300 A1B1 models, 12 clusters (tm-score), 2 input variants, 4 predictors
Every panel is the same UMAP of the same models; only the colouring changes. ● medoid of its cluster (highest membership) ringed; ★ a model already on a slate. Size,
confidence and predicted DockQ rarely pick the same cluster, which is why the slate takes one model from each of the first three.
grey: the rest of the pool
